photos.name: dough-temp-check-bulk
photos.summary: Dough in glass mixing bowl with instant-read thermometer showing 77.4°F during bulk fermentation. Aliquot jar with red lid visible beside the bowl. Dough looks smooth and cohesive.

photos.name: finished-loaf-closeup-ear
photos.summary: Close-up of finished sourdough boule on copper wire cooling rack. Deep golden brown crust with heavy blistering across the surface. Single score visible with slight ear lift.

photos.name: finished-loaf-wide-cooling-rack
photos.summary: Wide shot of finished sourdough boule on copper wire cooling rack. Good dome shape, golden brown with extensive crust blistering. Score visible on the side of the loaf.
